block.rightwayup.model.title: RightWayUp
block.rightwayup.model.description: Estimate image roll locally with ORTUS RightWayUp; track per-camera drift with confidence abstention and circular smoothing.
block.rightwayup.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.rightwayup.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.rightwayup.help_allowed_root: Only local files below this directory. Empty uses the application root; no URLs or symbolic links.
block.rightwayup.help_source_id: Used for plain paths. JSON frames can specify source_id to keep cameras separate.
block.rightwayup.help_tier: Nano is smallest; Fast is the default; Max is larger and slower. Weights are pinned to ORTUS 1.0.0.
block.rightwayup.help_device: CPU uses INT8. CUDA requires a working ONNX Runtime GPU installation; no silent CPU fallback.
block.rightwayup.help_download_missing: First frame only; no download during Run preparation. Verified weights stay in this node’s cache. Images never leave the server.
block.rightwayup.help_min_confidence: Reject low-confidence estimates, in addition to the model’s calibrated abstention policy.
block.rightwayup.help_abstention: Standard uses the tier’s calibrated threshold. Strict may reject more ambiguous images.
block.rightwayup.help_smoothing_window: Circular mean of accepted frames per source. The first full window defines the Run’s reference angle.
block.rightwayup.help_change_threshold_d: Emit rotated when drift reaches this threshold; returned below half. No repeated alert while still drifted.
block.rightwayup.help_min_interval_ms: During Active Runtime, only the latest pending frame per camera is retained. This does not configure the camera.
block.rightwayup.help_max_age_ms: Drop stale frames/results. Prepare the offline cache before a live stream to avoid first-download delay.
block.rightwayup.help_reset_after_sec: Start a new warm-up after this time without an accepted estimate. Tracking is not persisted across Runs.
block.rightwayup.help_max_sources: Bound per-source state and pending frames; additional source IDs are dropped until the next Run.
block.rightwayup.help_max_bytes: Reject oversized files before image decoding; default 10 MiB.
block.rightwayup.help_max_pixels: JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF or BMP; one frame only, with EXIF orientation applied.
block.rightwayup.help_threads: Bound ONNX intra-operation parallelism. One owned model process per active node.
block.rightwayup.help_timeout_sec: Stop cancels the owned process. Invalid frames report an error without intentionally failing the whole Run.
block.rightwayup.help_download_timeout_s: Additional time for the first load/download. Checksum failures are refused, never silently repaired.
